name: Obstacle Field
description: Static array of cylindrical pillars. Boids navigate around obstacles using flow-around vortex street avoidance. Produces territory formation and path memory.
notes: Each boid receives an additional avoidance force from every obstacle within u_obstacleRadius. The force is radially outward from the obstacle center, scaled as 1/dist^2. Large obstacles produce Von Karman vortex street patterns in the downstream boid flow — a direct analog of fluid dynamics in a biological substrate.
